Before doing anything destructive, let me verify what actually exists.

```python
import os, shutil, subprocess

print("=== Paths referenced ===")
for p in ('/tmp/crash_leader.sh', '/tmp/replicated_kv_data',
          '/tmp/start_replicated_kv.sh', '/tmp/replicated_kv_contract.md'):
    print(f"  {p}: exists={os.path.exists(p)}  isdir={os.path.isdir(p) if os.path.exists(p) else '-'}")

print("\n=== Full /tmp listing ===")
for e in sorted(os.listdir('/tmp')):
    p = os.path.join('/tmp', e)
    print(f"  [{'dir ' if os.path.isdir(p) else 'file'}] {e}")

print("\n=== Any directory named *data* / *kv* / *replicat* on disk ===")
for root in ('/tmp', '/mnt', '/opt', '/srv', '/var', '/home'):
    if not os.path.isdir(root):
        continue
    for dp, dns, fns in os.walk(root):
        dns[:] = [d for d in dns if d not in ('.cache','.config','.git','__pycache__','node_modules')]
        for d in list(dns):
            if any(k in d.lower() for k in ('kv','replicat','data','raft')):
                print("  ", os.path.join(dp, d))

print("\n=== Leader processes ===")
ps = subprocess.run("ps aux", shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
hits = [l for l in ps.splitlines() if any(k in l.lower() for k in ('kv','raft','leader','replica','consensus'))]
print("\n".join(hits) if hits else "  (none)")
```
